title: inoFISH: inosine fluorescence _in situ_ hybridization for visualizing adenosine to inosine RNA editing in single mammalian cells
protocol: Aspirate off media from multi-chambered slides using vacuum.
Add 1 mL PBS per well and aspirate off.
Repeat the 1 mL PBS rinse and aspirate step.
Add 1 mL Fixation solution to each well for cell fixation, allow cells to fix for 10 minutes, then aspirate off fixation solution.
Label the sample’s plate with the fixing date.
Add 1 mL PBS per well to rinse and aspirate off.
Repeat the 1 mL PBS rinse and aspirate step.
Add 1 mL 70% ethanol per well.
Parafilm the plate to prevent evaporation of ethanol.
Store at 4°C for a minimum of 1 hour, up to 3 months.
Add 50 μL hybridization buffer to Eppendorf tube (1.5 mL).
Vortex the mixture and spin down the tube.
Add 1 μL editing site detection single oligo probes at a stock concentration of 0.3-1.2 μM.
Add 1 μL mask oligo such that the mask:probe molar ratio is between 1:1 and 1.5:1.
Add 1 μL guide probe in Cal Fluor 610.
Aspirate off 70% ethanol from fixed cell sample well.
Add 1 mL wash buffer to each sample well.
Allow sample to equilibrate for 2-3 minutes.
Aspirate off wash buffer and tilt chamber to remove residual liquid.
Be quick so other samples do not dry out.
Add 50 μL of probe-containing hybridization buffer as a drop in the center of the sample.
Use clean tweezers to place a clean 18 x 18 mm coverslip onto the drop.
Tap down slide gently with tweezers to spread liquid.
Create “moisturizer” using half of Kimwipe rolled, tied into a pretzel, and saturated with 750 μL of 2X SSC.
Replace chamber cover, culture plate cover, and seal with parafilm.
Put in 37°C incubator overnight (or at least 4 hours).
Take out samples from 37°C incubator, remove parafilm.
Add 1 mL wash buffer to each sample well.
Use clean tweezers to remove coverglass insert.
Aspirate off wash buffer and replace with 1 mL fresh wash buffer.
Replace chamber and plate covers, seal with parafilm.
Put back into 37°C incubator for 30 minutes.
Start thawing DAPI (with 10 minutes left to spare).
Remove sample from incubator and remove parafilm.
Aspirate off wash buffer, add another 1 mL of wash buffer to each sample well.
Add 1 μL DAPI (50 μg/mL stock) to each sample well.
Replace covers, seal with parafilm and put back into 37°C incubator for 30 minutes.
During the second wash, prepare "Anti-Fade" buffer for each Cy5 sample.
Split anti-fade buffer into 100 μl and 900 μl volumes for each well.
Vortex catalase in its amber vial or aliquots from 4°C.
Take out glucose oxidase from -20°C only when ready to add.
Add 1 μL of oxidase enzyme and 1 μL of catalase to 100 μL anti-fade buffer.
Aspirate off wash buffer and add 1 mL of 2X SSC at room temperature, wait 1 minute.
Aspirate off 2X SSC and add 900 μL of anti-fade buffer (no enzyme) to each sample well.
Allow the buffer to equilibrate for 1 minute at room temperature then aspirate.
Add 100 μL of Anti-Fade with GluOx and Catalase to center of sample.
Use clean tweezers to add a clean coverslip to lightly squash and reduce O2.
Store samples at 4°C between imaging sessions.
Replace the well’s 100uL Anti-fade + GluOx and Catalase every 4 hours for imaging lasting more than 4 hours in a single well.
Ensure each image stack covers the entire body of a cell, starting blurry at the bottom and ending blurry at the top.
Inspect individual fluorescent channels and collections of channels using rajlabimagetools.
